name: Histriasaurus
isnote: Phylogenetic analyses published in 2007 and 2011 place it as the most basal rebbachisaurid, but the Wikipedia revision says only that it has been suggested to be one; its position below Rebbachisauridae is not settled.
sum: Histriasaurus is a possibly basal rebbachisaurid sauropod from the Early Cretaceous of Istria, Croatia.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: WN V-6, from a bone bed in lacustrine limestone off the coast of Bale, Istria.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Dalla Vecchia 1998
